mapper.select: select sku_id,quantity from wms_sale_out_detail where order_id =#{orderId}
select sku_id,sum(quantity) from wms_sale_out_detail where order_id =#{orderId} group by sku_id;

SELECT s.id AS skuId, s.sku_code AS skuCode, s.sku_name AS skuName, COALESCE(SUM(d.quantity), 0) AS totalQuantity FROM wms_sale_out_detail d INNER JOIN wms_sale_out o ON d.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN wms_sku s ON d.sku_id = s.id WHERE o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND o.status = 4 -- 4=已出库 GROUP BY s.id, s.sku_code, s.sku_name ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC LIMIT #{topN}
